metadata.description: Nohjen's marketplace of Claude Code plugins: skills, agents, commands, and hooks.

plugins.name: feature-flow
plugins.description: An end-to-end feature workflow: brainstorm options and review specs on pages you answer in place, audit umbrella specs, implement a spec in one session or with a team of agents checked by a read-only spec-verifier, and document what shipped — plus a read-only bug investigation. Every page and report can flag what you must know before committing, in red.
